post_clip.description: A man in a white shirt is standing beside a silver car with the driver's door open; as two men on a scooter approach and stop near him, he appears to quickly reach into the car (possibly retrieving or concealing an item) while looking toward the scooter riders. The timing and behavior—especially the open door, his hand movement inside the vehicle, and the proximity of the scooter riders who pause directly beside him—suggest a covert theft or snatch attempt, consistent with the expected anomaly type (stealing from an unattended or distracted person/vehicle). No weapon or overt threat is visible, but the interaction is suspicious and deviates from normal parking behavior.

A person emerges from the driver's side of the white hatchback (leftmost car) and appears to be holding or interacting with an object near the open door; this occurs in a static parking area with no other activity, consistent with covert theft from an unattended vehicle. The person’s posture and timing suggest concealment or removal of an item, matching the expected anomaly type of stealing from an unattended car.
